import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", None)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

exclude_cols = ["id", "target"]
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in exclude_cols]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"].copy()
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

print(f"Original features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Convert f_27 to category for proper handling
if "f_27" in feature_cols:
    X_train["f_27"] = X_train["f_27"].astype("category")
    X_test["f_27"] = X_test["f_27"].astype("category")

# Float features for interaction engineering
float_features = [
    "f_00",
    "f_01",
    "f_02",
    "f_03",
    "f_04",
    "f_05",
    "f_06",
    "f_19",
    "f_20",
    "f_21",
    "f_22",
    "f_23",
    "f_24",
    "f_25",
    "f_26",
    "f_28",
]

# Int features for interaction (low cardinality)
int_features = ["f_29", "f_30"]

print(f"Float features for interaction: {len(float_features)}")
print(f"Int features for interaction: {len(int_features)}")

# Step 1: Create float-float pairwise interactions (existing)
print("Creating float-float interactions...")
interaction_count = 0
for i in range(len(float_features)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(float_features)):
        f1, f2 = float_features[i], float_features[j]
        X_train[f"{f1}_{f2}_int"] = X_train[f1] * X_train[f2]
        X_test[f"{f1}_{f2}_int"] = X_test[f1] * X_test[f2]
        feature_cols.append(f"{f1}_{f2}_int")
        interaction_count += 1
print(f"Added {interaction_count} float-float interaction features")

# Step 2: Create float-int interactions (NEW IMPROVEMENT)
# Interactions between float features and low-cardinality int features
print("Creating float-int interactions...")
for f_int in int_features:
    for f_float in float_features:
        interaction_name = f"{f_float}_{f_int}_int"
        X_train[interaction_name] = X_train[f_float] * X_train[f_int]
        X_test[interaction_name] = X_test[f_float] * X_test[f_int]
        feature_cols.append(interaction_name)
num_float_int_interactions = len(int_features) * len(float_features)
print(f"Added {num_float_int_interactions} float-int interaction features")

# Ensure categorical features are properly marked
categorical_params = []
if "f_27" in feature_cols:
    categorical_params = ["f_27"]

# Split for validation - model never trains on this
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Parameters - optimized for this task
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "categorical_feature": categorical_params,
    "force_col_wise": True,
}

print(f"Total features after interaction engineering: {len(feature_cols)}")
print("Training model on training split...")
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model_split = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=300,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate AUC on held-out validation set
print("Evaluating on held-out validation set...")
val_pred = model_split.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model_split.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Create final submission - predict on test data only
print("Predicting on test data...")
test_pred = model_split.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model_split.best_iteration)

# Create submission file in required format
print("Saving submission file...")
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final validation AUC-ROC score: {val_auc:.6f}")

This addition expands the feature engineering to capture cross-feature interactions with the low-cardinality discrete features, which is more comprehensive than just float-float products without significantly increasing complexity.
